title: Butter Scraped Over Too Much Bread
why_read: A reflective essay using queueing theory as a metaphor for burnout in knowledge work, more of a thoughtful opinion piece than a technical resource.
analysis: This essay uses the M/M/1 queueing model, where a single server processes randomly arriving jobs, as a metaphor to explain why running people at 100% utilization like a server causes compounding delays and burnout. It is a decent use of a real technical concept to make a point about workload management, which gives it slightly more substance than a typical motivational post. However, the actual content is about workplace culture and burnout rather than teaching or demonstrating a technical skill. It may resonate with readers but offers limited new technical insight beyond the analogy itself.
